list: Official 55 trophies as published on PlayStation (names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026); guides written for this entry, each citing its sources.
sources_note: Official names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is in this entry's own words and names its sources; a fact with no source behind it is marked unconfirmed rather than invented.

trophies.guide: This one unlocks itself: earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops. There is no shortcut — it is the last trophy you will earn. Expect roughly 200 hours in total, most of it on the 100% completion checklist for A Long Road, so follow the roadmap in this guide (story first, then character quests, then the 100% checklist, then clean-up). Sources: GTABase trophy guide and roadmap (gtabase.com), PowerPyx platinum roadmap (~200 hours, difficulty 4/10), Exophase / PSNProfiles for the official list.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and the one the platinum run is really about. The 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) shows up after the story, but everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. Needed in full: all robberies (including the 8 bank vaults and the 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races, and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Only a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Work through the checklist after the credits — GTABase puts this stretch at around 100 hours. Sources: GTABase trophy guide (100% requirements) and PowerPyx (hardest trophy).
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy roadmap (via KeenGamer / EGamers)

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Progress > Activities > Stunts shows your count, and the map can show every Stunt Spot. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one. Source: GTABase trophy guide (stunt counts and tracking).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress > Activities shows what is left. Most of these come naturally while playing. Source: GTABase trophy guide (the 9 types).
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Get a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger (5 takedowns in one Combat Focus). Source: GTABase trophy guide (42 challenges, 12 ranges).
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough here, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so you may as well finish each location while you are there. Source: GTABase trophy guide (14 locations, 42 races).
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from. Winning the same race again does not count, so keep moving to new ones. Source: GTABase trophy guide (20 of 40).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge. Source: GTABase trophy guide (Feng Shui, purple icon, fishing quests).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick whichever you enjoy most and play it through. Source: GTABase trophy guide (the four games and where to find them).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. They are still there after the story, so nothing is missable here. Source: GTABase trophy guide (quest order, Chapter 3 start).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Source: GTABase trophy guide (7 shipwrecks, KR icon, tracking).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story. Source: GTABase trophy guide (Mudclub, Coffee Break, Hometown Heroes).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed at launch, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list to see which strands counted. None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story. Sources: GTABase trophy guide (who counts, who does not, unconfirmed remainder).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more. Source: GTABase trophy guide (16 cars, Key Cloner mission, where to look).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy. Source: GTABase trophy guide (Jason-only, purple labs, final job name).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE — the only possibly missable trophy in the game: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay. Sources: GTABase trophy guide (18 spots, balcony meditation, possibly missable), OutputLag trophy list (no mission replay, manual saves), PowerPyx via KeenGamer (only possibly missable trophy).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so finishing those covers it. Source: GTABase trophy guide (start, Target Decks, unconfirmed trigger).
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so chase the three nearest completion first. Source: GTABase trophy guide (any 3 sets, Progress tracking).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and it builds up on its own. Source: GTABase trophy guide (100 spots, controls, categories).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way — do not grind it early. Source: GTABase trophy guide (50 of 80, tracking, 100% needs 70).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there. Source: GTABase trophy guide (partner call, heat zone, tunnel, vaults).
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth. Source: GTABase trophy guide (partner, wanted state, jewelry stores, 30-second delay).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway on the road to A Long Road. Source: GTABase trophy guide (scan, no driving needed, 200 for 100%).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Source: GTABase trophy guide (controls, Focus prep, who counts).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge (planes parked out on the airfield do not count). Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. Source: GTABase trophy guide (gated jets only, 1 km, gates E3/E4).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Source: GTABase trophy guide (Mile Zero Air Station, south end of the base).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. Source: GTABase trophy guide (Snap Gun, back door, safe code note, Richardson).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000. Source: GTABase trophy guide (mission, van follow, partner bag, 5 of 8, payout).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts for this one too (see Maximum Withdrawal), as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults open, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away. Source: GTABase trophy guide (vault counts, sticky-bomb method).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed. Source: GTABase trophy guide (fog of war, plane method).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to A Long Road. Source: GTABase trophy guide (9 gangs, yellow icons, 39 for 100%).
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. That is all the official description confirms — the exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch, so this guide will not invent a bar or a button prompt. Check back as community guides confirm it. Sources: GTABase trophy guide (unconfirmed exact steps) and OutputLag trophy list (same).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom — a nod to the classic GTA opening. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch, so no specific showroom or method is claimed here until a guide confirms one. Sources: GTABase trophy guide (unconfirmed exact steps) and OutputLag trophy list.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back. Source: GTABase trophy guide (Kingpin Bowling, the three valuables, police escape).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. Source: GTABase trophy guide (max Strength both, partner training).
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count climb. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent. Source: GTABase trophy guide (500 profile actions, notification setting, Irredeemable warning).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch — no community guide has pinned down which second attempt counts — so this guide claims nothing more than the description supports. Sources: GTABase trophy guide (unconfirmed exact steps) and OutputLag trophy list.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet at launch, so this guide will not invent a location — watch community guides as players find it. Sources: GTABase trophy guide (unconfirmed exact steps) and OutputLag trophy list.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by). The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch, so no specific method is claimed here until a guide confirms one. Sources: GTABase trophy guide (unconfirmed exact steps) and OutputLag trophy list.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there. Source: GTABase trophy guide (Dye Pack Jammer, fences, Yasmani best price).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, so buy what you actually want and the total builds on its own. Source: GTABase trophy guide (running total, fastest shops).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Source: GTABase trophy guide (8 garages, app, price, story garages excluded).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. Source: GTABase trophy guide (Moses mission, Port Gellhorn, tracker rule, cost).
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
